description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguageDecorator class which provides a decorator/wrapper around the EmployeeLanguage entity, offering methods to retrieve fluency and competency details, and to set related Employee and Language entities by identifiers. It is part of the OrangeHRM project, extending its HR management system.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeLanguage entity, providing additional methods for retrieving fluency and competency as strings, and setting related Employee and Language entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeLanguage instance.

methods.name: getFluency
methods.description: Returns the fluency string for the associated EmployeeLanguage entity, based on predefined static mappings.

methods.name: getCompetency
methods.description: Returns the competency string for the associated EmployeeLanguage entity, based on predefined static mappings.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity for EmployeeLanguage based on the employee number.

methods.name: setLanguageById
methods.description: Sets the Language entity for EmployeeLanguage based on the language ID.
